about_the_game:
Terminal Colony: Deep Core is a survival management game played from a cold, humming terminal. You’ve been dropped into an aging extraction site buried miles beneath the planet’s crust. Systems are failing, pressure is rising, and something in the rock is awake. Type orders, reroute power, rebuild modules, and guide a handful of specialists through an unforgiving descent one decision at a time.

Click to generate resources, hire workers, and keep your deep core colony alive from a cold, humming terminal


Spend your hard won materials to expand modules, automate production, upgrade specialists.

Trigger Quantum Prestige to reset your run in exchange for powerful, permanent upgrades, unlocking advanced tech and unstoppable late game machines.


Features

  • Multi-Language: 100% Complete localization in 14 languages 

  •  English, German (Deutsch), Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Arabic (العربية), French (Français), Turkish (Türkçe), Polish (Polski), Italian (Italiano), Russian (Русский), Spanish (Español), Ukrainian (Українська), and Romanian (Română) 

  •  Colony Management: Hire and assign workers to specialized jobs with visual representation

  •  Deep Exploration: Drill through 4 geological layers with procedural block generation

  • Quantum Prestige: Reset with permanent bonuses through the Quantum Points system

  • Technology Tree: Research across 3 tiers (Basic, Advanced, Quantum) with meaningful upgrades and T key shortcut

  • Automation Systems: Deploy advanced machinery for autonomous resource generation including Quantum Excavator, Drone Swarm scaling (5x efficiency), and AI Core bonuses (+10% per core)

  •  Resource Economy: Manage 7 different resource types with complex interdependencies

  • Achievement System: Unlock 15+ achievements with permanent gameplay bonuses

  • Dynamic Events: Random events and boss encounters add excitement and risk/reward decisions

  •  Boss Encounters: Epic boss battles with dedicated attack buttons, health bars, and valuable defeat rewards

  • Persistent Progress: Auto-save system with manual save button and F5 shortcut ensures your colony never stops growing
